subject: gk
question: The MRTP Act of 1969 aimed at:

options.text: Regulating and controlling monopolistic and restrictive trade practices

solution:
The correct answer is __**Regulating and controlling monopolistic and restrictive trade practices**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• MRTP Act was repealed and is replaced by the Competition Act, 2002, with effect from September 1, 2009.
 
• The Monopolistic and Restrictive Trade Practices Act, 1969, was enacted
 
 
• To ensure that the operation of the economic system does not result in the concentration of economic power in hands of a few.
 
• To provide for the control of monopolies.
 
• To prohibit monopolistic and restrictive trade practices.
 
 
 
• The Competition Act was passed in 2002 and has been amended by the Competition (Amendment) Act, 2007.
